english_full:
Just as outer fear is inferior to love, so inner fear is superior to love.

28.39. From the preceding conclusion it is known why in Genesis Abraham

is praised for his fear, although we know through the property of piety that he

did all things out of love.

28.40. Whenever we do not know the property from which an influence exists over a petition we are making, we should turn to the lord of the nose.
